en: A black-and-white postcard view of a large Renaissance castle complex with an inner courtyard garden laid out in geometric flowerbeds and paths. The multi-story building has rows of shuttered windows, corner towers, and arcaded loggias along one side. A high defensive wall with battlements and a square tower runs along the right. At the bottom right border there is printed caption text identifying the place.
